description: This PHP source file contains functions for handling AJAX operations related to the Upgrade Wizard in SuiteCRM. It includes functions for executing SQL scripts, post-install activities, schema validation, file permission checks, and upgrade file management, facilitating the upgrade process through asynchronous requests.

methods.name: ajaxSqlProgress
methods.description: Displays progress of executing SQL queries during the upgrade process, updating the UI with current status and completion percentage.

methods.name: commitAjaxFinalTouches
methods.description: Performs final post-installation activities after an upgrade, including rebuilding caches, registering upgrade history, and sending reminders.

methods.name: commitAjaxRunSql
methods.description: Executes a single SQL statement from the prepared list during the upgrade, handling errors and providing progress feedback.

methods.name: commitAjaxGetSqlErrors
methods.description: Returns accumulated SQL errors encountered during the upgrade for display.

methods.name: commitAjaxPrepSql
methods.description: Prepares SQL schema check scripts for sequential execution during the upgrade process.

methods.name: commitAjaxPostInstall
methods.description: Handles post-install tasks such as updating version info, running post-install scripts, and rebuilding configuration files.

methods.name: preflightCheckJsonFindUpgradeFiles
methods.description: Identifies files in the upgrade archive, unzipping files if necessary, and preparing file lists for validation.

methods.name: preflightCheckJsonDiffFiles
methods.description: Verifies md5 checksums of files to detect differences and prepares a list of files requiring manual merge or overwrite.

methods.name: preflightCheckJsonGetDiff
methods.description: Generates HTML UI components to present file differences and options for overwriting or preserving files.

methods.name: preflightCheckJsonPrepSchemaCheck
methods.description: Loads SQL schema scripts, parses them into individual statements for validation, and prepares for execution.

methods.name: preflightCheckJsonSchemaCheck
methods.description: Verifies individual SQL statements for correctness before applying changes to the database.

methods.name: preflightCheckJsonGetSchemaErrors
methods.description: Displays errors encountered during schema validation of SQL scripts.

methods.name: preflightCheckJsonFillSchema
methods.description: Displays the content of SQL schema scripts for review.

methods.name: preflightCheckJsonAlterTableCharset
methods.description: Indicates whether charset alterations are needed; currently shows not needed.

methods.name: systemCheckJsonGetFiles
methods.description: Performs a system scan to list directories and files, preparing for permission checking.

methods.name: systemCheckJsonCheckFiles
methods.description: Checks permissions of files, reporting any issues with writability, ownership, or group settings.
